Subject: BeaconHealth - Exec workshop: hybrid readiness & travel contingency

Hi Ananya,

Thanks again for confirming the week of June 20 for the executive workshop. Per our call today, I'm sending a set of tentative calendar holds and a short plan for hybrid readiness + travel contingency so you can review with your PMs and facilities team.

Quick summary:
- Onsite core days: Tue, Jun 22 - Thu, Jun 24 (San Francisco office)
- Virtual prep day: Mon, Jun 21 (to align on goals and pre-reads)
- Target attendee list: CEO, CTO, Head of Prod, Security lead (+ our two facilitators)
- Timezone plan: SF core hours 09:30-16:30 PT; we will run two-hour overlapping blocks for APAC/EU participants where required

Action items for BeaconHealth:
1) Confirm final attendee list and whether Security will join onsite or remote (reply by Fri, May 14)
2) Approve attached prework agenda and timezone matrix (I attached beacon_prework_agenda.pdf and proposed_timezone_matrix.csv)
3) Share any travel-reimbursement policy or preferred vendor for flights/hotels so we can align logistics

I've added tentative calendar holds (invites will follow once attendees are confirmed). If travel is tight for any execs we should discuss a travel contingency plan (remote facilitator fallback + recorded micro-sessions).

Attachments: beacon_prework_agenda.pdf, proposed_timezone_matrix.csv

Thanks — looking forward to making this smooth.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Flight itineraries and final meeting room confirmations will be coordinated by Marcus once we have the attendee list.

Thanks for the quick reply. Fallback options we recommend:
- Record the overlap block and schedule a live 30-min sync with the APAC lead later that day (we can facilitate asynchronously with notes + action tracker).
- Assign a deputy from BeaconHealth (a senior PM) to cover the core overlap; we can prep the deputy during the virtual pre-day.
- If neither is possible, we can run a short private briefing earlier or later with the APAC lead and provide a summarized recording to the exec group.

Tessa (cc'd) will own the remote facilitation plan and the async notes template. Priyom will prepare the travel contingency runbook (hotel + flight buffer suggestions).

I'll mark the calendar holds as provisional and follow up with formal invites and room reservations once we have the attendee list.

Best,
Vanessa

Thanks Luis — great catch on the AV lead time. Marcus and Priyom on our side will coordinate AV redundancy and travel coordination:

- Marcus: I'll loop you into the room AV spec doc (we'll confirm the encoder/backups). If BeaconHealth prefers to manage AV, Redwood will provide the hybrid facilitation kit (backup encoder + tabletop mics) and remote-streaming keys.
- Priyom: I'll ask you to draft the travel contingency runbook and a one-page checklist for exec arrivals (buffer flights, carry-on strategy, hotel check-in windows).

Next steps (timeline):
- May 14: Redwood to confirm AV encoder plan and provisional kit list
- May 17: BeaconHealth to confirm final attendee list and Sterling Travel contact info
- May 21: Formal calendar invites with confirmed rooms and travel stubs; DocuSign NDA for on-prem data handling will be sent earlier this week

I've attached a flight_itinerary_stub.txt showing the buffer windows we recommend (sample only). I'll also create a short shared Drive folder with final agenda and facilitation notes once attendees are confirmed: https://drive.example.com/open?id=1Abeacon-agenda
